tasks.short: Read structural drawings for materials and fabrication sequence

steps.what: Locate the current engineering drawings and specifications for the fabrication job
Interpret drawings to determine metal sections, dimensions, and materials requirements
Determine the fabrication task sequence and resolve drawing ambiguities

tasks.design: Configure job-linked retrieval of the released drawing pack from {DOCS} and {OPS_SYSTEM}. The fabricator checks revision status, interprets geometry and materials, and determines a feasible sequence; retrieval does not infer an engineering requirement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable released drawing can interrupt interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: A controlled job-to-document link can reduce repeated searching.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting tolerances, sections, joining details, and fit-up constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The fabricator recognises conflicts between a drawing and practical assembly access.
tasks.altitude: A little less document searching; fabrication decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain access or sequencing constraints before scheduling
reach.learn: Assembly dependencies and engineering change controls

evidence.claim: Azumuta supplies variant-specific work instructions from production jobs; that supports job-linked document delivery, not automated structural drawing interpretation.
A retrieval-only improvement may save a small part of drawing-study effort; the estimate is E1.

assumptions: Boundary covers finding and studying job drawings, excluding procurement, physical fitting, and welding.

The document controller maintains existing job identifier, drawing identifier, revision, release status, and file location before s1. Fabricator selects the job and checks applicability in s1; that capture and check time remains. Missing or conflicting register entries require manual retrieval and engineering clarification.
Native job links and document search are tested before custom code. Existing register maintenance is unchanged; extra link checking is budgeted below.
No OCR-derived dimensions, material choices, or machine instructions are accepted automatically.
unknowns: Whether drawings are already linked to jobs
research_questions: Does job-linked retrieval reduce searching without increasing wrong-revision use?

already_counted.description: Check drawing applicability and revision during retrieval

incremental.description: Report and verify broken job-to-drawing links
Correct document links and test released-version delivery

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94; gross 6 minus 2 focal upkeep gives net 4. Range assumes repeated searches in a usable register; already-linked jobs may save nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design and construct hand-built templates and fixtures

steps.what: Design templates and fixtures for the required metal shape and fit
Construct and trial-fit templates and fixtures using hand tools

tasks.design: Keep fixture design and hand-tool construction with the fabricator. Existing specifications in {DOCS} inform the work, but no digital output substitutes for physical fabrication and trial fit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful fixtures depend on actual geometry, restraint, and tool access.
tasks.enabler_now: No change to the physical construction method is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Preventing distortion and achieving a reliable fit with available materials.
tasks.human_edge: The fabricator tests contact and stability on the actual workpiece.
tasks.altitude: Design and construction responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Hand-built fixture design and construction retain physical and contextual work; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary covers designing and hand-building work aids, not the separate study of production drawings or machining a digital design.
Fabricator measures the workpiece and creates the layouts in s1; capture and construction remain fully counted. No structured geometry feed or automated fabrication is assumed.
Use existing drawing access; no custom software, new process, or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Which fit and restraint requirements can only be verified on the physical workpiece?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero. Fixture design, hand construction, and trial fitting remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct weld build-up of low spots and short pieces

steps.what: Direct welders on where and how to build up low spots or short pieces

tasks.design: Keep workpiece-specific build-up directions and clarification with the fabricator. Applicable repair instructions in {DOCS} remain reference material rather than an automatic repair decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: The direction depends on actual fit, dimensions, and the permissible repair method.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated interpretation or execution is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising when a dimensional issue needs engineering review rather than weld build-up.
tasks.human_edge: The fabricator can point out the exact surface and clarify the required result with the welder.
tasks.altitude: Workpiece direction and repair boundaries remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Approved repair procedures and engineering escalation

evidence.claim: Directing a workpiece-specific weld build-up remains human coordination; no automation saving is supported.

assumptions: Boundary is fabricator direction and clarification. Welding execution and any engineering repair authorisation are separate unchanged work, excluded from focal savings.

Fabricator observes and measures the actual low spot or short piece during s1; existing authorised repair instructions come from the engineering or welding authority. No inferred defect code or structured measurement feed is introduced.
Native document access remains sufficient; an unchanged process adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which dimensional issues must be escalated before any build-up direction is given?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Human direction is unchanged and welder execution is outside the denominator.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The fabricator may spend less time locating released drawings while retaining material, sequencing, fixture, and repair judgements.
role.ambitious_version: A fabricator who works from the correct drawings and gives clear, workpiece-specific directions.
